# TDD loop (Matt Pocock)

A compact red-green-refactor guide focused on good tests, seams and avoiding mocks.

- Source: https://github.com/mattpocock/skills
- SKILL.md: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mattpocock/skills/main/skills/engineering/tdd/SKILL.md
- Author: Matt Pocock
- License: MIT
- Page: https://commandvault.ai/commands/tdd-loop-matt-pocock-b41cc1ab

Used when you want to build or fix something test-first. It defines what a good test looks like, where test seams belong, which anti-patterns to avoid (especially heavy mocking), and the rules of the loop. Extra notes cover mocking and test style. Short and opinionated, from Matt Pocock's widely used skills collection.

**Try asking:**
- "Build the cart total function test-first"
- "Fix this bug with red-green-refactor"
- "Add integration tests for the signup flow"
